notes: Source is the Mistral Docs model page (https://docs.mistral.ai/models/model-cards/mistral-medium-3-1-25-08, redirects to /models/mistral-medium-3-1-25-08). It is a product/model catalog page (release wording, context 128k, modalities label, features, deprecation), not a safety system card: no risk tiers, no safety topics, no numeric eval tables, no Weights tab (so no params/license). Modality icons were not available as plain text; modalities recorded only as the page word 'multimodal'. Header shows August 12, 2025; releaseDate uses the explicit 'released August 2025' wording. A Legal link points to https://legal.mistral.ai/ai-governance/models/mistral-medium-3 (lifecycle table for Medium 3.x); that page was not the seed document and was not used for quotes. No pageCount (web page). alsoDocuments empty per seed-lookup.
